name: FDCS Farmer (Free)
summary: Scan crops, find out what's wrong and whether the produce is safe to eat.
description: Everything a smallholder farmer needs: camera and upload scanning, pest and disease identification with organism classification, a safe-to-eat verdict, treatment advice and 30 days of scan history.

name: FDCS Pro Farmer
summary: Offline Android app, unlimited history and PDF scan reports.
description: The Android app with the on-device TFLite model so you can scan in the field without data, unlimited history, exportable reports and priority support.

name: FDCS Cooperative
summary: For farmer groups and extension officers managing many farms.
description: Up to 50 farmer accounts, a shared outbreak dashboard, farm-level reports and training sessions for extension officers.

name: Fall Armyworm Pheromone Trap
summary: Catches male moths to warn you before an outbreak.
description: Funnel trap with species-specific lures. Place 1-2 traps per acre at crop height to track moth flights and time your scouting.

name: Tuta absoluta Delta Trap
summary: Monitoring and mass trapping of tomato leafminer moths.
description: Delta trap with sticky insert and Tuta absoluta lure for tomato fields and greenhouses.

name: Yellow Sticky Traps (pack of 20)
summary: Attract and catch whiteflies, aphids and leafminer adults.
description: Double-sided yellow sticky cards, 20 x 25 cm, for early detection of flying pests. Hang just above the crop canopy.

name: Blue Sticky Traps (pack of 20)
description: Double-sided blue sticky cards for thrips monitoring in onion, cowpea, tomato and pepper.

name: 20x Field Hand Lens
summary: See mites, thrips and eggs clearly in the field.
description: Folding 20x magnifier with LED light, essential for identifying mites, young larvae and egg masses.

name: Insect-Proof Nursery Net
summary: Protects seedlings from whiteflies, moths and aphids.
description: Fine 50-mesh UV-stabilised netting for nurseries and small plots. Keeps out whitefly, leafminer moths and aphids while allowing air flow.
price_source: estimate (fibre/aluminium insect nets GH₵80-600 on Jiji)

name: 16 L Knapsack Sprayer
summary: Reliable manual sprayer with adjustable nozzle.
description: 16 litre piston knapsack sprayer with padded straps, pressure chamber and cone and fan nozzles.
price_source: Supply Master: TOTAL 16L GH₵330; Jiji GH₵159-380 (Sep 2026)

name: Spraying Safety (PPE) Kit
summary: Gloves, goggles, mask and apron for safe spraying.
description: Nitrile gloves, splash goggles, respirator mask with filters and a waterproof apron. Always wear protection when handling any pesticide, including organic ones.
price_source: estimate (3M half-face respirator alone GH₵270 on Jiji)

name: Cold-Pressed Neem Oil (1 L)
summary: Botanical spray for aphids, whiteflies, mites and caterpillars.
description: Cold-pressed neem seed oil. Mix with water and a little soap as directed; spray in the evening on both sides of leaves.

name: Bt Biopesticide (500 g)
description: Bacterial biopesticide effective against young caterpillars such as fall armyworm, diamondback moth and Tuta absoluta. Safe for bees and natural enemies when used as directed.

name: Hermetic Grain Storage Bags (5 pack)
summary: Airtight triple-layer bags that stop weevils and mould in stored grain.
description: Triple-layer airtight bags for maize, groundnut and beans. Starving insects of oxygen stops weevil damage, and keeping grain dry prevents aflatoxin mould. Dry grain below 13% moisture before bagging.

name: Digital Grain Moisture Meter
summary: Check grain is dry enough (below 13%) to store safely.
description: Handheld meter for maize, rice, groundnut and beans. Grain stored above about 13% moisture can grow aflatoxin-producing mould; this tells you when it's safe to bag.
